metadata.description: Taiwan.md — the open-source, AI-native knowledge base about Taiwan. Connect it to your AI for citation-backed answers, or turn your machine into one of its working nodes.

plugins.name: taiwanmd
plugins.description: Ask Taiwan.md anything about Taiwan and get source-backed answers instead of guesses — 860+ curated, citation-backed articles across 12 languages, served by a local MCP server with no API key. Includes the contributor-node skill, which turns a scheduled Claude Code run on your own machine into a working node: it picks one open task (a missing translation, a broken link, a metadata gap), does it, and opens a pull request. Merge always stays with a human.
